# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser Canvas game called **Swamp Side-Eye: Bog Court Bash**. Preserve the mechanics of a card-driven lane tower-defense game: four-card hand, regenerating resource, unit deployment only from the player's half, spells anywhere, AI enemy spawns, two bridge lanes, tower/boss HP, story timer, survival waves, persistent gold and upgrades, sell/refund, win/loss/end screens.

Reinterpret everything through: Shrek fairy-tale parody adventure. A Shrek fairy-tale parody adventure game with swampy irreverence, oddball friendship, anti-princess humor, pop-culture jokes, chaotic charm, and lovable gross-out fantasy with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The player defends an ogre swamp hut using oddball friends and gross-out fairy-tale pranks against a vain castle. Use procedural swamp visuals: green-brown bog, soup moat, rickety bridges, onion icons, donkey/fairy/dragon jokes, fireflies, bubbles, crooked storybook silhouettes, large touch-friendly cards, readable mobile HUD, short playful copy, and compact audio/GIF feedback from approved catalogs.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a portrait mobile Canvas tower-defense/card-deployment game. The player starts from menu, opens story briefing or survival, spends regenerating elixir/influence from four hand cards, deploys units only on the lower half of the field while spells may target anywhere, and protects a bottom tower/hut while damaging the top enemy tower or boss. AI spends its own resource to spawn opposing units. Units move toward bridge lanes, acquire closest enemies, attack by melee or projectiles, drop persistent gold on death, and trigger win/loss when a tower or boss dies or the story timer expires.

## Protected mechanics
- Start, story briefing, survival, shop, end, continue, menu, and mute state flow.
- Pointer card selection, selected-card deploy on canvas, lower-half unit restriction, spell exception, sell/refund action.
- Elixir regeneration, storm/surge acceleration, AI elixir and spawn cadence, deck cycling, card costs and stats.
- Entity movement, target acquisition, ranges, projectile hit behavior, HP bars, tower/boss death win/loss, timer failure, gold/upgrades persistence.

## Remixed target
`Swamp Side-Eye: Bog Court Bash` reframes the same battle as a swampy fairy-tale parody: an ogre-like antihero defends a hut, recruits oddball friends, and humiliates a vanity castle full of princes, fairy deputies, and merch-table royalty. Mechanics remain unchanged; meaning, copy, procedural art, HUD, palette, and feedback become irreverent swamp fantasy.

## Runtime approach
Single-file browser-native HTML/CSS/Canvas/vanilla JS. No new engine. Approved Google fonts and catalog audio/GIF URLs are used as small accents; procedural Canvas owns the playfield.
